findings.issue: Recall annotation not bound to exact raw generation or explicit corrected-annotation receipt; nonmemory cold-review N/A flags can authorize fabricated memory credit.
findings.reproduction: In-memory c_replace_001 raw recall_probe=null changed to support1/probe4/focus invented user preference; memory_probe_credit=true. verify_new and verify_full_content both returned4. No source artifact changed.
findings.remediation: Require exact selected annotation binding and semantic-valid evidence; verify credit derives from that evidence and recheck focus, bounds and >=2gap. Explicitly refuse promotion of null original probe without separate reviewed annotation receipt.

findings.issue: Standalone verification reads mutable worker-c/selection-receipt.json rather than row-pinned fresh_selection_receipt and does not validate memory_review_receipt/credit.
findings.remediation: Load row pinned receipt by path+SHA and match selected entry plus annotation object; reject mutated credit/fields and missing evidence.

findings.issue: List-form review_receipts check hash and turn indices but not pass decision, rationale or assistant turn count.
findings.remediation: Require exact pass decision/count/rationale; failed/exclude list entry must not be silently accepted alongside dict pass.

findings.issue: Cold review JSON is hash-checked but CLI events/request/freshness/model/tool policy and messages-only review are not enforced.
findings.remediation: Verify review call event/request sidecars and output equivalence as for generation; require at least one qualifying fresh messages-only cold review for final content.

findings.issue: Revision cap enforced only if optional total_generation_revisions is present; omission bypasses it.
findings.remediation: Require explicit count with generation-history chain or pinned supplemental ledger, reject unknown count or >2.

findings.issue: Legacy selected rows bind messages but not source/provenance/generation metadata to immutable baseline; old parent-authored row can be relabelled exact CLI model and analyze_selection will count that label.
findings.remediation: Compare immutable baseline provenance keys for legacy records; allow only enumerated new selection/annotation fields.

not_findings: Native tokenizer checks include both policies, actual reply targets, prefix identity and reserved context.
Overlap tool accurately limits claims to lexical screen and uses only exposed comparators.
Assembly enforces immutable versioned output bytes and production/training/model-quality flags remain false.
remaining: Parent fixes and regression rejection checks; report does not claim these issues remain after later edits.
